title: Contribution
description: Generic Blackboard contribution wrapper. Engine attaches id / contributorKsId / kind / derivedFrom / createdAt / supersedes. KSs cannot fabricate them.

slot.description: Slot name within `panel` (one of the panel's closed contribution-type set).

targetIdentityKey.description: Required for target-group panels (Archetype/Statement/Granularity/Evidence/Confidence) and for Definition Merge slots referencing prior identities. Null for source-group panels.

value.description: Panel-specific value (validated against the panel's value schema).

contributorKsId.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the producing KS, of the Pack's Instructions Provider, or of the user-mediated override channel.

kind.description: Provenance class of the contribution. KS_DERIVED = posted by a KS via execve; INSTRUCTIONS_DERIVED = posted by the Initializer from the Instructions Provider's payload before Control starts; USER_OVERRIDE = posted by a Reviewer at a Checkpoint (requires checkpointId).

checkpointId.description: Required when kind = USER_OVERRIDE. Identifies the suspended Checkpoint at which the Reviewer authored the override.

cacheKey.description: Required when determinism = NON_DETERMINISTIC. Stable hash of (KS id, KS version, all read inputs).

derivedFrom.description: Ids of contributions read by the KS to produce this one.

supersedes.description: Ids of contributions this one supersedes (engine-set).
